assets.title: Materials fit different jobs
assets.caption: A clear window lets us see outside. A knitted sweater bends with us and can help keep us warm. Different jobs need different properties.

assets.title: Choosing a rain cover
assets.caption: Untreated paper towel can soak through and tear when wet. That makes it a poor rain cover. Coated papers can behave differently, so name the sample you test.

Gentle water drops from above have darkened the paper and made a small tear; a few drops pass through to the toy. A tray catches water. No child in rain.

assets.title: Prepare a fair comparison
assets.caption: Compare equal-size dry samples using the same water amount, waiting time, and method. Change the sample material. Repeat with fresh dry samples.

assets.title: Observe without guessing a winner
assets.caption: Notice damp areas and water still on the surface. Wet-patch size alone does not tell us which sample absorbed more. Report what you actually observe.

assets.title: Find materials around you
assets.caption: Find an object, name its job, and describe a useful property. Many objects use several materials together.

assets.title: Bending is not stretching
assets.caption: Bending changes how something curves. Stretching makes it longer. A material can bend without stretching much.

assets.title: Hard does not mean unbreakable
assets.caption: Ceramic can resist dents yet chip or break. Being hard does not mean being unbreakable. An adult handles sharp or broken samples.

assets.title: Compare surface texture
assets.caption: Rough and smooth describe surface texture. Look closely before safely touching a sample. Texture is different from how easily it bends.

assets.title: Seeing through materials
assets.caption: Clear material lets you see details through it. Cloudy material lets some light through but hides details. An opaque panel blocks the view.

assets.caption: Use a template to keep sample area the same. Keep thickness and layers alike when possible, and describe differences you cannot control.

assets.title: Try again with fresh samples
assets.caption: Repeat the comparison using fresh dry samples. A used wet sample is a different starting condition. Similar trials make your evidence more dependable.
